name: Anthropic & Claude
description: Claude models and apps, Claude Code, the Claude developer platform, partnerships, research and safety policy.

items.title: Anthropic releases Claude for Nonprofits plugin
items.summary: Anthropic released a Claude for Nonprofits plugin, built with about 30 nonprofit organizations, with skills and connectors for fundraising, marketing, hiring, and related operational work. It is included at no additional cost for nonprofits on Team and Enterprise plans; Anthropic also plans to extend its Claude Corps program through a Taproot partnership.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.311 adds self-hosted runner controls and reliability fixes
items.summary: Anthropic published Claude Code v2.1.311 with new `--hold-idle-file` and `--max-hold-min` controls for self-hosted runners, alongside fixes spanning startup freezes, context handling, MCP tools, and background sessions. The release also changes `ultrathink` to run at xhigh effort on specified Claude models through Anthropic’s API.

items.title: Claude Code contributor Thariq says he has left Anthropic
items.summary: Thariq publicly said he had left Anthropic after more than a year working on Claude Code. His post thanked colleagues and the Claude Code community; it is notable personnel news related to Claude Code, though it does not announce a product change.
